ns2:section.sectionText: This is a fast-paced, online course taught in the Moodle course management system with no face to face classroom sessions. All assessments will be conducted online. Weekly, one-hour exams will be administered online between 2 and 6 PM Fridays. The last exam will be administered online 8 AM - noon, 2 August. One, hour-long, synchronous, online discussion session is required during the course (to be arranged). Further information at: http://www.life.illinois.edu/bio100/ib100onl.html.
